name: GD Screen Recorder
description: Record your gameplay directly inside Geometry Dash. Captures video with GPU-accelerated encoding (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel) and falls back to CPU automatically. Supports two independent audio tracks — microphone (Track 1) and game audio via WASAPI loopback (Track 2), so you can mute each separately in any video editor. Uses async PBO readback for zero-stall frame capture. Requires ffmpeg.exe placed in the Geometry Dash folder — download at gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds. Hotkeys: F5 start/stop · F8 cycle mic · F9 cycle audio device · F11 toggle indicator · F12 screenshot.

quality.name: Video Quality
quality.description: 1 = Low (small file). 2 = Medium. 3 = High. 4 = Ultra (large file)

fps.name: Recording FPS
fps.description: Frames per second. 60 = smooth, 30 = less space

output-dir.name: Output Folder
output-dir.description: Where to save videos. Empty = GD/recordings folder

show-indicator.name: Show Indicator
show-indicator.description: Blinking REC indicator on screen. Toggle with F11

mic-enabled.name: Record Microphone (Track 1)
mic-enabled.description: Record microphone as audio Track 1. Press F8 in-game to select mic device from a popup list.

mic-device.name: Microphone Device
mic-device.description: Device number ("1", "2") or exact name. Press F8 in-game to pick from active devices. Empty = default mic.

game-audio-enabled.name: Record Game Audio (Track 2)
game-audio-enabled.description: Record game audio as Track 2 via WASAPI loopback. Press F9 in-game to select output device.

game-audio-device.name: Game Audio Device
game-audio-device.description: Output device number or name. Press F9 in-game to pick from active devices. Empty = default output.
